dct_creator_sm: Environics Institute for Survey Research (Environics Research Group, Toronto, ON).
dct_description_sm:
Environics reports generated from this dataset include “Canada’s Relationships with Other Countries,” “Canadian Public Opinion about the Middle East Conflict,” and “Canadian Public Opinion about Immigration and Refugees.”

The dataset contains two weight variables: WEIGHT and FINAL_WGT.

The wave variable was deleted from the dataset.

The Spring 2025 data file is not included in this dataset.

As part of its Focus Canada public opinion research program (launched in 1976), the Environics Institute updated its research on Canadian public opinion about immigration and refugees, conflict in the Middle East, and relationships with other countries. This survey was conducted in partnership with the Diversity Institute at Toronto Metropolitan University, and with the ongoing support of the Century Initiative.

The survey is based on telephone interviews conducted (via landline and cellphones) with 2,004 Canadians between September 8 and 21, 2025. A sample of this size drawn from the population produces results accurate to within plus or minus 2.2 percentage points in 19 out of 20 samples. All results are presented as percentages, unless otherwise noted.
